rows.title: Attachment View
rows.help: How pictures and files show in the composer and in sent messages.

rows.title: Composer Ring
rows.help: What the ring at the end of the composer shows.

rows.title: Dictation App Shortcut
rows.help: The shortcut sent to your dictation app. Empty uses the app's default.

rows.title: Edited Files Card
rows.help: The card that lists a turn's edited files, with Undo and View changes.

rows.title: Web Images in Replies
rows.help: A web image loads from its site, which then sees that you read the reply.

rows.title: Files Outside the Project
rows.help: What a link to a file outside the chat's folders does. Keys and .env files never open.

rows.title: Needs You
rows.help: A badge in the chat header counts what your agents wait on.

rows.title: Start New Chats In
rows.help: Cloud copies your project to your Cloud machine. A chat's composer can change it.

rows.title: Scroll to Bottom When I Send
rows.help: When off, sending while you are reading up keeps your place and shows new messages below.

rows.title: Show Context Usage
rows.help: The ring beside the model that fills as the chat uses its context window.

rows.title: Show Dictation Button
rows.help: The microphone beside Send in every composer, including the New Tab page.

rows.title: Show Machine Load Warnings
rows.help: Shows a warning when a remote machine is at its CPU or memory budget in the Computer menu.

rows.title: Check Spelling While Typing
rows.help: Underlines misspellings and offers system suggestions in the composer.

rows.title: Agent Chat Zoom
rows.help: The display size for agent chat. Cmd-0 resets it.

rows.title: Retries per Error
rows.help: How many times the chat tries again before it stops and waits for you.

rows.title: Retry Automatically
rows.help: Retries after rate limits, capacity errors or a dropped connection.

rows.title: Seconds Between Retries
rows.help: 0 waits longer after each failed try.

rows.title: Compact Before the Cache Expires
rows.help: Compacts an idle Claude chat while its cache is warm, so the next message costs less.

rows.title: Only Above Context Used (%)
rows.help: Chats using less of their context window than this are left as they are.

rows.title: Compress Old Chats
rows.help: Unused chats are compressed into one small file each and open as before.

rows.title: Compress Chats Idle For
rows.help: Days unused before a chat is compressed. Busy chats never are.

rows.title: Discover Chat Folders
rows.help: Find harness chat folders automatically. When off, only the listed folders are used.

rows.title: Enable Chats
rows.help: Show chats stored on this device. Nothing is uploaded.

rows.title: Chat Folders
rows.help: Folders agents may also use.

rows.title: Session Recap
rows.help: A line on where a Claude chat stands when you come back. Each is a small model call.

rows.title: Permission Mode for New Chats
rows.help: What a new chat may do without asking. A mode you pick in a chat applies to that chat only.

rows.title: cmux Guidance for Claude Code
rows.help: Tells new Claude Code chats how cmux shows plans, side sessions and recaps.

rows.title: cmux Guidance for Codex
rows.help: Tells new Codex chats how cmux shows plans, side sessions and recaps.

rows.title: cmux Guidance for Other Agents
rows.help: Gemini, OpenCode and agents you added get the same guidance.

rows.title: Your Skills in Every Chat
rows.help: Skills in ~/.config/cmux/skills (a folder with a SKILL.md each) reach every new chat.

rows.title: cmux Model Router Model
rows.help: The model new cmux model router chats start on.

rows.title: Prompt Cache
rows.help: One hour keeps replies after a pause cheap; its cache writes cost a little more.

rows.title: Suggest Next Prompt
rows.help: Suggests your next prompt in grey; Tab takes it. Each one is an extra model call.

rows.title: Let Sessions Answer Their Sub-sessions' Questions
rows.help: When an agent in a sub-session asks a question, the session that started it can answer, and the answer shows who gave it. Permission requests always wait for you. Off: only you answer.

rows.title: Let Agents Start Sub-sessions
rows.help: Agents can start sessions that work in parallel, shown under theirs.

rows.title: Open Sub-sessions per Session
rows.help: Finished and closed sub-sessions don't count.

rows.title: Deepest Nesting
rows.help: 1 means sub-sessions cannot start their own.

rows.title: Running Sub-sessions per Session
rows.help: More wait their turn. Lowering it never stops running ones.

rows.title: Trust My Own Folders Without Asking
rows.help: Agents start in folders under your project roots, and in repositories owned by your organizations, without asking. Other folders ask first.

rows.title: Trusted GitHub Owners
rows.help: A repository is trusted when all of its GitHub remotes belong to these users or organizations.

rows.title: Trusted Project Roots
rows.help: Everything inside these folders is trusted. Use full paths or ~/ paths.

rows.title: Show Announcements
rows.help: Short cards from the cmux team above Settings, shown when the pointer is over the sidebar.

rows.title: Download Announcements
rows.help: Off: cmux never asks the network for announcements. The request carries no identifiers.

rows.title: Ask Before Quitting Ends Agents or Terminals
rows.help: Ask before Cmd-Q ends agents or terminals.

rows.title: Global Hot Key
rows.help: Show/Hide All Windows (⌃⌥⌘.) works while another app is in front.

rows.title: Hide Dock Icon When No Windows Are Open
rows.help: cmux stays in the menu bar until a window opens.

rows.title: When Quitting
rows.help: Terminals run in cmux-tui and keep running after cmux quits unless you end them.

rows.title: Start Agent from Any App
rows.help: ⌃⌥⌘Space starts an agent while another app is in front.

rows.title: Warn Before Closing a Working Agent
Warn Before Closing a Running Program
Tab Text Size
rows.help: Text size of tab titles. Unset, tabs follow the interface size.

rows.title: Maximum Tab Width
rows.help: Widest a tab gets when the strip has room.

rows.title: Minimum Selected Tab Width
rows.help: The selected tab stays at least this wide when tabs shrink.

rows.title: Minimum Tab Width
rows.help: Narrowest the other tabs get before the strip scrolls.

rows.title: Pinned Tab Width
rows.help: Width of a pinned tab.

rows.title: Tab Bar Height
rows.help: Height of a pane's tab bar. Its tabs grow and shrink with it.

rows.title: Browser Toolbar Position
rows.help: Where the address bar of browser and Markdown panes sits.

rows.title: Default Chat Target
rows.help: Where cmux chat starts a chat with no --on: here, cloud, vm:NAME or a device name.

rows.title: Computer Use Driver
rows.help: Upstream is the new helper; macOS asks for its permissions again.

rows.title: Computer Use
rows.help: Agents can see and use your apps. macOS asks for Accessibility and Screen Recording.

rows.title: Live Preview in Chat
rows.help: A small live view of the app an agent uses. Click it for Agent Activity.

rows.title: Text Editor
rows.help: An app name, bundle ID or app path. Empty uses your source code app.

rows.title: Free AI Model Without Sign-In
rows.help: Agents can use the free cmux model while signed out. cmux checks this is a real Mac.

rows.title: Keep Recently Closed Items For
rows.help: Each machine deletes closed items that are older. 0 keeps them however old they are.

rows.title: Recently Closed Items to Keep
rows.help: Older closed tabs, workspaces and windows are deleted. 0 keeps them all.

rows.title: Keep Terminal Commands For
rows.help: Each machine deletes recorded commands that are older.

rows.title: Record Terminal Commands
rows.help: Lists finished shell commands in History. Command lines can contain secrets.

rows.title: Focus After Closing a Pane
rows.help: Which pane gets focus when the focused pane closes.

rows.title: Column Width Presets
rows.help: Widths a column cycles through, as fractions of the visible strip width.

rows.title: Fixed Column Width
rows.help: A share of the window width, for Fixed Width new columns.

rows.title: Focus Follows Mouse
rows.help: Pointing at or scrolling over a pane focuses it.

rows.title: Main Pane
rows.help: Keeps a chat as the main pane, with what it opens in a column on its right.

rows.title: New Terminals and Browsers
rows.help: Split Automatically splits the largest pane.

rows.title: Web Pages Get Command + Scroll First
rows.help: Pages like Figma keep Command + Scroll. Off, it always moves columns.

rows.title: Rows
rows.help: Off hides New Row and fits a column's existing rows into it without scrolling.

rows.title: Scroll Areas
rows.help: Panes that do not fit scroll sideways instead of shrinking.

rows.title: Scroll Columns and Rows With
rows.help: What moves columns and rows: Command + Scroll, or a plain sideways scroll.

rows.title: Split Sizing
rows.help: Even gives every pane in the column the same size after a split.

rows.title: Strip Margin
rows.help: Space between the window edge and the columns.

rows.title: Column Scroll Bar
rows.help: A thin bar under the columns that shows and moves the visible range.

rows.title: Split for Browsers Too
rows.help: With Split Automatically, new browsers also get their own pane instead of a tab.

rows.title: Back and Forward Steps
rows.help: Everything also steps through tabs and panes inside a workspace.

rows.title: Back and Forward
rows.help: What Go Back and Go Forward walk.

rows.title: New Terminal Opens a Workspace
rows.help: Hold Option to reverse it for one click.

rows.title: Commands Prefix
rows.help: Typed into an empty query, this character enters the scope.

rows.title: Scope List Prefix
rows.help: Typed into an empty query, this character enters the scope.

rows.title: Settings Prefix
rows.help: Typed into an empty query, this character enters the scope.

rows.title: Tabs Prefix
rows.help: Typed into an empty query, this character enters the scope.

rows.title: Workspaces Prefix
rows.help: Typed into an empty query, this character enters the scope.

rows.title: Remember Palette Searches
rows.help: Rows you pick and use often rank higher. Off records nothing.

rows.title: Pinned Folders
rows.help: Listed under Locations. Use full or ~/ paths.

rows.title: End Sharing When cmux Quits
rows.help: Off: this Mac stays available to your devices while cmux is quit.

rows.title: Ultra Connection Mode
rows.help: Sends repair data so lossy networks stay fast. Always uses 2 to 3 times the data.

rows.title: Find Screenshot Apps
rows.help: Also shows the folders of apps like CleanShot X and Shottr.

rows.title: More Screenshot Folders
rows.help: Also shows the pictures and videos in these folders.

rows.title: Allow Full-Access Modes
rows.help: Off, cmux won't switch an agent into a mode that skips approvals.

rows.title: Keep Mac Awake While Agents Work
rows.help: Stops idle sleep while an agent works. Closing the lid still sleeps the Mac.

rows.title: Also While Terminal Commands Run
rows.help: A build or test running over a minute keeps the Mac awake.

rows.title: Suggest Follow-Up Tasks
rows.help: Agents suggest next tasks you can start as child chats.

rows.title: Resume Agents After Restart
rows.help: Terminal agents reopen their session after a crash or restart.

rows.title: Workspace Icons
rows.help: An icon per workspace title. "*" sets the rest; an empty icon hides it.

rows.title: Tab Bar and Browser Toolbar
rows.help: Whether the tab bar sits above or below the address bar.

rows.title: Hide the Tab of a Chat Alone in Its Pane
Native New Tab Page
rows.help: Cmd-T opens the faster native New Tab page. Recent chats and widgets are web only.

rows.title: New Tab App
rows.help: An extension id that draws New Tab, such as "local/showcase-newtab". Unset: cmux's own.

rows.title: Show Now Playing on New Tab
rows.help: A player for what is playing, on the New Tab page.

rows.title: New Tab Template
rows.help: The layout of the New Tab page. Terminal opens a terminal instead.

rows.title: Tab Overflow
rows.help: Shrink narrows tabs before scrolling; Scroll keeps them wide.

rows.title: + Button Visibility
rows.help: Applies in Minimal Mode; otherwise the + always shows.

rows.title: Swap Cmd-T and Cmd-N
rows.help: Cmd-T opens a workspace and Cmd-N opens a tab.

rows.title: Use Vertical Tabs for All Workspaces
rows.help: Tabs in a list beside the panes. A tab bar's menu changes one workspace.

rows.title: Expand Collapsed Vertical Tabs on Hover
rows.help: Show titles while the pointer is over the collapsed list.

rows.title: Tasks Layout
rows.help: Inbox lists what needs you first, with the task beside it. Changes apply at once.

rows.title: Update Channel
rows.help: Stable gets builds that ran a week without problems; Canary and Dev get them first.

rows.title: Download Updates Automatically
rows.help: Off: cmux asks before downloading. It always asks before restarting.

rows.title: Install Within
rows.help: A nightly installs when you are idle, and never waits longer than this.

rows.title: Quiet Time Before Installing
rows.help: How long you must be idle before a nightly installs.

rows.title: Install Updates When Quitting
rows.help: A downloaded update installs as cmux quits. Terminals keep running.

rows.title: Keep Previous Versions
rows.help: Earlier builds kept so you can roll back. Uses almost no disk until files change.

rows.title: cmux Live
rows.help: Lets cmux live start show your checkout's web UI, each saved edit at once.

rows.title: On Metered Networks
rows.help: While downloads wait, a found update shows on Settings and one click downloads it.

rows.title: Update in One Click
rows.help: One click on Update downloads, installs and restarts. Terminals and agents keep running.

rows.title: Show Feature Tips
rows.help: A small tip now and then points at a feature an update added.

rows.title: Show What's New After Updates
rows.help: A sidebar card links to What's New after an update.

rows.title: Web UI Updates
rows.help: Every Merge gets web UI changes minutes after they land.

rows.title: Install Versions from What's New
rows.help: An Install button for each version listed in What's New.

rows.title: Titlebar
rows.help: Minimal has no titlebar strip; the top row moves the window.

rows.title: Titlebar Buttons
rows.help: With the sidebar hidden, On Hover shows its buttons only over the top row.

rows.title: Idle For
rows.help: Days unopened and unchanged. Pinned, running and waiting workspaces never archive.

rows.title: Idle Workspaces
rows.help: Archived workspaces stay dimmed in their group and come back when opened.

rows.title: Name Workspaces from Tabs
rows.help: An unnamed workspace shows its front tab's name. Your own name always wins.

rows.title: Free Idle Agents
rows.help: Also ends idle Claude Code and Codex sessions; opening the tab resumes them.

rows.title: Free Idle Terminals
rows.help: Ends idle shells of long-unused workspaces; they restart in the same folder.

rows.title: Free Terminals After
rows.help: Minutes before a hibernated workspace's idle shells end (1440 is a day).

rows.title: Running Commands
rows.help: What happens to a command that still runs in a workspace that frees its terminals.

rows.title: Hibernate Idle Workspaces
rows.help: Frees the memory of unused workspaces. Terminals and agents keep running.

rows.title: Hibernate Hidden Spaces After
rows.help: Idle minutes before the workspaces of a space no window shows hibernate.

rows.title: Hibernate After
rows.help: Minutes a workspace goes unopened and unchanged before it hibernates.

rows.title: Chat Code Font
rows.help: Empty uses the Markdown viewer's code font.

rows.title: Chat Code Size
rows.help: Code as a share of the chat's text size. Empty uses the Markdown viewer's.

rows.title: Session Info Chip
rows.help: Where the chip sits: under the tabs (Left) or in the header (Right).

rows.title: Play Sound When Work Finishes
rows.help: A soft sound when a long turn ends, its checks pass or its pull request merges.

rows.title: Chat Interface Font
rows.help: The font of the whole chat: replies, the composer, cards and menus.

rows.title: Chat Full Width
rows.help: The chat fills the whole pane instead of the text width.

rows.title: Chat Minimap
rows.help: What runs down the chat's edge.

rows.title: Pin Task List in Chat
rows.help: Keeps the agent's task list under the latest message, not over the composer.

rows.title: Prompt Coach
rows.help: After a chat with many corrections, shows a better first prompt.

rows.title: Prompt Rail Side
rows.help: Right-click the rail to move it.

rows.title: Sender Badge
rows.help: The small colored glyph on a sender's icon that tells sessions of one model family apart.

rows.title: Sender Badge Corner
rows.help: Where the small glyph sits on a sender's icon.

rows.title: Sender Icon Emphasis
rows.help: Which is big in a sender's icon: the model's mark or the session badge.

rows.title: Session Info
rows.help: Push narrows the chat; Overlay covers it.

rows.title: Custom Working Verbs
rows.help: Comma-separated -ing verbs for the live status line.

rows.title: Working Status Verbs
rows.help: Choose whether the live status line rotates through verbs or stays on Thinking.

rows.title: Transcript View
rows.help: How much of each turn a chat shows. A chat's ··· menu sets its own.

rows.title: Running Tray Handle
rows.help: Where the running tray's handle sits on top of the composer.

rows.title: Tuck Away Running Tray
rows.help: Hides the running work bar. Hover the top of the composer to bring it back.

rows.title: Unread Banner
rows.help: A banner for new turns when you come back to a chat. Right-click it to hide it.

rows.title: VS Code Minimap
rows.help: A small picture of the whole chat at its right edge. Click or drag it to scroll.

rows.title: Chat Text Width
rows.help: The widest the chat's column gets. On a wider pane the chat stays centered.

rows.title: App Zoom
rows.help: Zoom for chat, Settings and other app pages.

rows.title: Accent
rows.help: The color of selection, focus and the Send button.

rows.title: App Theme
rows.help: Colors for the window, sidebar, tabs and pages. Terminals use Terminal Theme.

rows.title: Background
rows.help: A painting, your wallpaper or a macOS wallpaper behind the window.

rows.title: Material
rows.help: Unset, the window follows Ghostty's background-opacity and background-blur.

rows.title: Dark Picture
rows.help: Unset, it shows the light picture.

rows.title: Dynamic Wallpaper
rows.help: Follow light and dark, or change with the sun through the day.

rows.title: Light Picture
rows.help: Unset, it shows the dark picture.

rows.title: Sun Location
rows.help: Latitude,longitude for sunrise and sunset, such as 37.77,-122.42. Unset: your time zone.

rows.title: Opacity
rows.help: How much of the theme color covers the material behind the window.

rows.title: Change Picture
rows.help: How often a shuffled background changes.

rows.title: Time of Day Pictures
rows.help: A time (07:00) or sun event (sunset-30m) for each picture.

rows.title: Borders
rows.help: None removes every border, hairline and separator in the app.

rows.title: Window Style
rows.help: Whether panes sit in one rounded card, and where lines are drawn.

rows.title: Bezier X1
rows.help: A control point of the Custom (Bezier) curve, as in CSS cubic-bezier().

rows.title: Bezier X2
rows.help: A control point of the Custom (Bezier) curve, as in CSS cubic-bezier().

rows.title: Bezier Y1
rows.help: A control point of the Custom (Bezier) curve, as in CSS cubic-bezier().

rows.title: Bezier Y2
rows.help: A control point of the Custom (Bezier) curve, as in CSS cubic-bezier().

rows.title: Color Blend Space
rows.help: OKLab blends with even lightness. sRGB mixes the red, green and blue channels.

rows.title: Color Change Curve
rows.help: How a color change moves over its duration.

rows.title: Color Change Duration
rows.help: How long a color change takes. 0 changes colors at once.

rows.title: Animate Color Changes
rows.help: Old colors blend into new ones on workspace and theme changes.

rows.title: With Reduce Motion
rows.help: What color changes do while Reduce Motion is on in macOS.

rows.title: Spring Damping
rows.help: 1 arrives smoothly with no overshoot. Above 1 is slower; below 1 arrives sooner.

rows.title: Spring Response
rows.help: Seconds a spring color change takes to reach its new colors.

rows.title: Density
rows.help: Row height, padding, corners, icons and text size together.

rows.title: Per-display Background Rotation
rows.help: Display ID to 15m, hourly or daily. Others use the global rotation.

rows.title: Per-display Backgrounds
rows.help: Display ID to daily, folder:<path>, desktop, a background or none.

rows.title: Experimental Appearance Controls
rows.help: Applies Hue and Saturation to the window's tint. Off, they have no effect.

rows.title: Starred Themes
rows.help: Themes starred in a theme picker. The picker lists them first.

rows.title: Focused Pane
rows.help: How the focused pane stands out.

rows.title: Text Smoothing
rows.help: How text draws. Some text changes after cmux restarts; terminals keep their own.

rows.title: Highlight Color
rows.help: The color of selected text everywhere. Unset uses the terminal theme's.

rows.title: Hue
rows.help: Shift the tint color around the hue wheel.

rows.title: Dim Inactive Windows
rows.help: How much windows behind the front one are tinted. 0 keeps them the same.

rows.title: Text Size
rows.help: Text size of tabs, the sidebar and chat. Terminals have their own size.

rows.title: Pane Backgrounds
rows.help: One background behind the window, or a copy in each pane.

rows.title: Rotate Starred Themes
rows.help: Switches the terminal theme to the next starred one. Needs two starred themes.

rows.title: Saturation
rows.help: Increase or reduce the tint color intensity.

rows.title: Sidebar Background
rows.help: Separate shades the sidebar darker than the main pane.

rows.title: Status Indicators
rows.help: Static draws a still, distinct shape for each state. Reduce Motion always uses Static.

rows.title: Let Statuses Choose Their Style
rows.help: A status that asks for a style (cmux status set --style) uses it.

rows.title: Show Agent Working on Tabs
rows.help: Three dots take the tab's icon place while an agent works.

rows.title: Show Page Loading on Tabs
rows.help: A spinner takes a browser tab's icon place while its page loads.

rows.title: Style
rows.help: How sidebar rows, tabs and panes show work in progress.

rows.title: Theme
rows.help: Colors for terminals. A space, workspace or terminal theme overrides it.

rows.title: Theme Edits
rows.help: Your color changes to a theme, such as "Rose Pine/background": "#1f1d2e".

rows.title: Theme File
rows.help: A theme file in ~/.config/cmux/themes, such as "tokyo" for tokyo.json.

rows.title: Title Area Contrast
rows.help: How much darker the title bar, tab bar and sidebar are. 1 is the default.

rows.title: Title Area
rows.help: The title bar, tab bar and sidebar in the content's color, or shaded apart.

rows.title: Tint with Desktop Wallpaper
rows.help: The glass takes the colors of your desktop picture.

rows.title: Stage All and Revert All Bar
Unfocused Pane Tabs
rows.help: How other panes' tabs look subtler when Focused Pane marks tabs.

rows.title: Corner Padding
rows.help: Space between a pane's edge and its tabs. Inner corners use the corner radius minus this.

rows.title: Corner Radius
rows.help: One radius for panes, tabs, panels, popovers and cards.

rows.title: Separation
rows.help: How panes are told apart.

rows.title: Code Font
rows.help: Empty uses the terminal font.

rows.title: Code Font Size
rows.help: Code size as a share of the text size.

rows.title: Default Font Size
rows.help: The size viewers open at. Cmd-= and Cmd-- change one viewer.

rows.title: Full Width
rows.help: Text fills the whole pane instead of the text width.

rows.title: Text Width
rows.help: The widest a line gets, in characters.

rows.title: Load Web Images Automatically
rows.help: Image sites can see your address and when you open a document.

rows.title: Paragraph Spacing
rows.help: The gap after each paragraph, as a share of the text size.

rows.title: Border
rows.help: A line on the sidebar's edge. Off, the edge shows a line only while you hover or drag it.

rows.title: Bottom Sections Height
rows.help: The share of the sidebar the bottom sections fill before they scroll.

rows.title: Show Tips
rows.help: A daily card shows one cmux feature you have not used yet.

rows.title: Chrome-Style Groups
rows.help: Groups get a colored rail with a rounded end, like Chrome's tab groups.

rows.title: Command-9
rows.help: Goes to the last item, as in browsers, or to the ninth.

rows.title: Show Sidebar Controls Only on Hover
rows.help: The sidebar's buttons show only while the pointer is over it.

rows.title: Sidebar Density
rows.help: Expanded shows status, age, pull request and computer under each name.

rows.title: Detailed Status Icons
rows.help: Icons for working, waiting, error and done. Off: a spinner and a dot.

rows.title: Float Hidden Sidebar on Hover
rows.help: With the sidebar hidden, point at the window's edge to show it over your work.

rows.title: Group Gradient
rows.help: The gradient Group Colors uses when set to Gradient.

rows.title: Group Background
rows.help: How a group's background draws. Sections shows plain headings instead.

rows.title: Show Group Member Count
rows.help: A collapsed group shows how many workspaces it holds.

rows.title: Show Group Unread Count
rows.help: A collapsed group shows its unread notification count.

rows.title: Group Colors
rows.help: Where group colors come from. A color you pick for a group stays.

rows.title: Hover Card Delay
rows.help: How long the pointer rests before a card opens.

rows.title: Show Hover Cards
rows.help: A card with details opens when the pointer rests on a workspace or a tab.

rows.title: Group Card Delay
rows.help: How long the pointer rests on a group before its summary card opens.

rows.title: Group Card Members
rows.help: The most members a group's card lists by name.

rows.title: Group Card Leads With
rows.help: Which part of a group's card comes first.

rows.title: Group Card: Latest Activity
rows.help: Show the member that changed last, and when.

rows.title: Group Card: Branches
rows.help: Show the members' git branches.

rows.title: Group Card: Members
rows.help: Show the member count and the members' names.

rows.title: Group Card: Ports
rows.help: Show the members' listening ports.

rows.title: Group Card: Status
rows.help: Show how many members work, wait, failed or have unread items.

rows.title: Cards on Tab Groups
rows.help: A summary card opens when the pointer rests on a tab group's chip.

rows.title: Cards on Workspace Groups
rows.help: A summary card opens when the pointer rests on a workspace group's header.

rows.title: Workspace Card Layout
rows.help: What a workspace's hover card shows.

rows.title: Workspace Card History Lines
rows.help: The most prompts, waits and finished turns a workspace's card lists. The list scrolls.

rows.title: Show Branch in Workspace Cards
rows.help: The workspace's branch and pull request.

rows.title: Show Ports in Workspace Cards
rows.help: The ports the workspace listens on.

rows.title: Show Prompts in Workspace Cards
rows.help: Each prompt you sent and when, in the card's history.

rows.title: Show Running Times in Workspace Cards
rows.help: How long the workspace has worked or waited, and how long its command has run.

rows.title: Show Waits in Workspace Cards
rows.help: When an agent waited for your input or finished its turn, in the card's history.

rows.title: Minimal Mode
rows.help: Sidebar and tab bar buttons show only while the pointer is over them.

rows.title: Hide Bands Until Hover
rows.help: Hides the chosen sections until the pointer is over the sidebar.

rows.title: Show Whole Sidebar Without Fade
rows.help: Stops the sidebar's edges fading and hides the bottom profile and search bar.

rows.title: Show Now Playing
rows.help: A player for what is playing, at the bottom of the sidebar.

rows.title: Include Other Apps in Now Playing
rows.help: Also shows what plays in apps like Spotify or Music.

rows.title: Command-Number Shortcuts
rows.help: Every Item: Home is Command-1. Workspaces Only: the first workspace is Command-1.

rows.title: Scroll Tall Sections
rows.help: Off: the top and bottom sections never scroll and the workspace list gets smaller.

rows.title: Priority View
rows.help: A bell listing every agent chat, the ones waiting on you first.

rows.title: Show Priority View
rows.help: The sidebar bell's state while the Priority view is on. Off, the sidebar is unchanged.

rows.title: Section Look
rows.help: How the sections above and below the workspace list draw.

rows.title: Session Tree
rows.help: Lists workspaces an agent started under the workspace that started them.

rows.title: Show All Chats on New Tab
rows.help: New Tab lists every agent chat on this computer, not only recent ones.

rows.title: Mark This Mac's Workspaces
rows.help: With more than one computer, this Mac's workspaces show its icon too.

rows.title: Show New Workspace Menu Button
rows.help: A chevron beside the + opens the New Workspace menu. Off: right-click the +.

rows.title: Show Search Button
rows.help: A search button after the profile button. Off: search from the palette.

rows.title: Show Timestamps
rows.help: Rows show when they last changed, such as 3d.

rows.title: Sidebar Side
rows.help: On the right, the window buttons sit over the tab bar.

rows.title: Workspaces Side by Side
rows.help: Drag a workspace row onto a pane's edge to show it beside the current one.

rows.title: Spaces Position
rows.help: Under the window buttons or above the Settings row.

rows.title: Show Spaces
rows.help: On Hover hides the spaces with the other sidebar controls.

rows.title: Next and Previous Item
rows.help: What Command-Control-] and Command-Control-[ step through.

rows.title: Wrap Around
rows.help: Past the last item, the next item is the first again.

rows.title: Sidebar Style
rows.help: Rail shrinks the sidebar to a strip; point at it to open the full sidebar.

rows.title: Sidebar Text Size
rows.help: Makes the sidebar's names, icons and rows larger together.

rows.title: Top Sections Height
rows.help: The share of the sidebar the top sections fill before they scroll.

rows.title: Agent Status
rows.help: The status agents and hooks report, one line each.

rows.title: Icon
rows.help: The icon or emoji you chose for a workspace.

rows.title: Log
rows.help: The newest line agents and scripts log: cmux workspace log append <text>.

rows.title: Latest Notification
rows.help: The text of the workspace's newest unread notification.

rows.title: Ports
rows.help: Set by a hook: cmux workspace status set ports <text>.

rows.title: Running Program
rows.help: The terminal's title, which the shell or program sets.

rows.title: Progress
rows.help: A progress bar under the row and the busy mark of running work.

rows.title: Pull Request
rows.help: Set by a hook: cmux workspace status set pr <text>.

rows.title: Second Line Order
rows.help: The order of the shown items under the workspace name.

rows.title: Agent Working
rows.help: A mark while an agent works in the workspace.

rows.title: Workspaces as Tabs
rows.help: Each workspace is one line, and Cmd-Shift-[ and ] switch workspaces.

rows.title: Show Running Commands
rows.help: A shell command that runs a while shows as busy.

rows.title: Command-1 to 9 Select
rows.help: Control-1 to 9 selects the other one.

rows.title: Animate the Agent Cursor
rows.help: The agent cursor glides and shows click ripples.

rows.title: Play Animations
rows.help: Off turns every animation off. On, the switches below pick by area.

rows.title: Animate Highlights and Colors
rows.help: Hover, press, focus and theme color changes ease in.

rows.title: Animate Home and Chats
rows.help: The Chief chat, its bubbles, the composer and the Home list move and fade.

rows.title: Animate Hover Cards
rows.help: Hover cards and tooltips fade and slide in. Off: they show and hide at once.

rows.title: Animate Spinners and Progress
rows.help: Spinners turn, status dots pulse and attention flashes blink.

rows.title: Animate New Tabs
rows.help: A new tab grows into its place in the tab bar. Off shows it there at once.

rows.title: Animate New Workspaces
rows.help: A new workspace row opens in the sidebar. Off shows it there at once.

rows.title: Animate Menus and Cards
rows.help: Menus, popovers, the palette, sheets, toasts and cards fade and slide.

rows.title: Animate Panes and Windows
rows.help: Splits, closes, zooms, dividers and windows move with motion.

rows.title: Animate the Sidebar
rows.help: Rows, groups and the sidebar itself slide as they change.

rows.title: Animate Tabs
rows.help: Tabs grow, shrink and slide as they open, close and move.

rows.title: Animate cmux Web Pages
rows.help: Animations in cmux's own pages, such as chats and New Tab. Websites are unchanged.

rows.title: Calm Mode
rows.help: Calm stops sliding, spinning and hover highlights; Still also makes animations instant.

rows.title: Animate Panes
rows.help: Splits, closes, moves, zooms and column scrolls slide into place.

rows.title: Plain Backgrounds
rows.help: The plain theme color, without paintings, wallpapers or glass.

rows.title: Traffic Light Clearance
rows.help: Space kept free for the window's close, minimize and zoom buttons.

rows.title: Workspace Color Style
rows.help: How a workspace's color shows in the sidebar.

rows.title: Font Family
rows.help: A monospaced font installed on this Mac.

rows.title: Open Program Links In
rows.help: Where terminal programs open URLs: cmux, system, chrome, safari, app:<name> or command:<cmd>.

rows.title: Program Link Rules
rows.help: <match> -> <target>, first match wins. Example: caller:gh github.com -> safari

rows.title: Terminal Type (TERM)
rows.help: xterm-ghostty needs Ghostty's terminfo on every host you ssh to.

rows.title: Detect Indentation
rows.help: Tab size and spaces follow the file's own indentation.

rows.title: Copy the Line When Nothing Is Selected
Font Family
rows.help: Empty uses the terminal font.

rows.title: Font Size
rows.help: Empty uses the terminal font size. Cmd-= and Cmd-- change it in one editor.

rows.title: Format on Save
rows.help: Runs the language's formatter when one is installed.

rows.title: Take Defaults From
rows.help: cmux reads that editor's settings and keybindings, never changing them.

rows.title: End Files with a Newline on Save
Insert Spaces
rows.help: Tab inserts spaces. Off inserts a tab character.

rows.title: Line Height
rows.help: 0 computes it from the font size. A value under 8 multiplies the font size.

rows.title: Zoom with Command and the Scroll Wheel
Add a Cursor With
rows.help: The key you hold while you click to add a cursor.

rows.title: Rulers
rows.help: Columns where a vertical line shows.

rows.title: Sticky Scroll
rows.help: The lines that open the scopes around the top line stay at the top while you scroll.

rows.title: Word Wrap
rows.help: Opt-Z turns it on and off.

rows.title: Longest Agent Pointer Move
rows.help: The longest time one agent pointer move takes with human motion. Short moves take less.

rows.title: Agent Pointer Motion
rows.help: Human moves along a curve and pauses before clicks; Instant jumps.

rows.title: Built-in uBlock Origin
rows.help: Blocks ads and trackers in Chromium tabs. Takes effect after cmux restarts.

rows.title: Custom Search Address
rows.help: Used when Search Engine is Custom. Put {searchTerms} where the typed text goes.

rows.title: Custom Suggestions Address
rows.help: An OpenSearch suggestions URL, with {searchTerms} for the typed text.

rows.title: Browser Engine
rows.help: Browser tabs and cmux pages, such as History and Apps, open in this engine.

rows.title: Enable cmux Browser
rows.help: Off: every link opens in your default browser.

rows.title: Freeze Hidden Tabs
rows.help: A hidden Chromium tab stops running until you show it, to save power.

rows.title: Hibernate Hidden Tabs
rows.help: Frees memory; history and position are kept.

rows.title: Never Hibernate
rows.help: Hosts such as mail.google.com or *.example.com.

rows.title: Hosts to Open in Embedded Browser
rows.help: Only these hosts open in cmux, such as *.example.com. Empty opens all.

rows.title: Offer to Import Cookies
rows.help: Browser tabs offer to import cookies from your other browsers.

rows.title: Keep Imported Cookies in Sync
rows.help: Brings over changed cookies from the browser you imported from. Stays on this Mac.

rows.title: Import from Other Browsers
rows.help: Offers to import bookmarks, history, passwords and sign-ins. Off hides the offers.

rows.title: Keep Neighbor Tabs Awake
rows.help: Tabs beside the shown one stay loaded so switching is instant. 0 turns it off.

rows.title: Command-Click
rows.help: In Chromium tabs, Download keeps Chrome's default.

rows.title: Shift-Command-Click
rows.help: Shift-middle-click does the same.

rows.title: Middle-Click
rows.help: Chromium tabs use the Command-Click setting.

rows.title: Option-Click
rows.help: Chromium tabs always download.

rows.title: Shift-Click
rows.help: In Chromium tabs, Download keeps Chrome's default.

rows.title: New Tab Page
rows.help: An address such as https://example.com. Empty opens a blank page.

rows.title: Address Bar Opacity
rows.help: How much the address bar covers a see-through window.

rows.title: Calculator Answers
rows.help: Shows the answer to arithmetic you type. Return copies it.

rows.title: Address Bar Corners
rows.help: Match Theme uses the standard bar radius. Capsule rounds the ends fully.

rows.title: Address Bar Text Size
rows.help: The size of the address and the suggestions. Match Density follows the density.

rows.title: Glass Tint
rows.help: The color over the glass, from the terminal theme.

rows.title: Address Bar Height
rows.help: Match Density follows the density. The bar always grows to fit its text.

rows.title: Complete Addresses Inline
rows.help: Completes a site you typed before or visit often.

rows.title: Search Suggestions
rows.help: Sends what you type to the search engine. Never addresses, files or local hosts.

rows.title: Address Bar Shadow
rows.help: A soft shadow under the glass address bar.

rows.title: Always Show Full URLs
rows.help: Shows the whole address, with https:// and www., when you are not editing it.

rows.title: Open Links in cmux Browser
rows.help: Off: links open in your default browser. Shift-Cmd-click opens the other one.

rows.title: Open Pull Requests in cmux GitHub Page
rows.help: Pull request links in agent chats open cmux's GitHub page. Off: github.com in a tab.

rows.title: Open Sign-In Pages in cmux Browser
rows.help: Sign-in pages open in cmux even when other links open in your default browser.

rows.title: Allow Password Export
rows.help: The Passwords page can export every password to a plain-text CSV, after Touch ID.

rows.title: Suggest Strong Passwords
rows.help: Offers a generated password when a site asks for a new one, and saves it.

rows.title: Offer to Save Passwords
rows.help: A browser tab asks to save a sign-in you submit. Tabs an agent drives never ask.

rows.title: Open localhost on the Workspace's Machine
Search Engine
rows.help: The address bar searches here and asks it for suggestions.

rows.title: Show Agent Cursor
rows.help: Shows an agent's cursor, clicks and typing in browser tabs. Passwords show dots.

rows.title: Show Bookmarks Bar
rows.help: A row of bookmarks under each browser toolbar.

rows.title: Show Loading Bar
rows.help: A thin line under the address bar while a page loads.

rows.title: Site Engines
rows.help: Sites that always open in chromium or webkit, such as spotify.com.

rows.title: Toolbar Buttons
rows.help: The rest are in the More menu.

rows.title: URLs to Always Open Externally
rows.help: Text matches anywhere; * and ? are wildcards; re: starts a regular expression.

rows.title: Email Accounts for Codes
rows.help: Codes come only from these addresses. Mail is read on this Mac, never stored or sent.

rows.title: Fill Codes from Verification Emails
rows.help: Offers emailed codes on the sender's own site. Never filled without your click.

rows.title: Vim Keys in Pages
rows.help: Outside text fields: f clicks a link, j and k scroll, gg and Shift-G jump to the ends.

rows.title: Wake Tabs on Hover
rows.help: Sleeping pages start loading when the pointer rests on their tab. Uses more memory.

rows.title: Picture in Picture
rows.help: Offer Picture in Picture for web videos.

rows.title: Route Subagents to the Best Agent
rows.help: The Chief picks each subagent's agent, such as Codex for code. Off: the Chief's own.

rows.title: Chief Permission Mode
rows.help: How the Chief's own turns handle permissions. Bypass runs every command without asking. Auto lets a safety check decide each command. Manual refuses each change that would need approval. Applies from the next turn.

rows.title: Reaction Classifier Harness
rows.help: The agent that reads reactions, such as claude or codex. Empty uses the Chief's.

rows.title: Reaction Classifier Model
rows.help: The model that decides whether a reaction starts a turn.

rows.title: Reaction Classifier Instructions
rows.help: What the classifier is told when it decides. Empty uses the built-in instructions.

rows.title: Reactions Can Wake the Chief
rows.help: A reaction on a Chief message can start a turn, such as ? on a question.

rows.title: Subagent Workspaces
rows.help: Where subagent workspaces go: the sidebar or the collapsed Chief's group.

rows.title: Chief's Workspaces for Tasks That Mention
rows.help: Words that put a subagent in Chief's workspaces, added to the built-in ones.

rows.title: Sidebar for Tasks Longer Than
rows.help: Tasks with at least this many words go in the sidebar.

rows.title: Sidebar for Tasks That Mention
rows.help: Words that put a subagent in the sidebar, added to the built-in ones.

rows.title: Send Hang Reports
rows.help: Nightly builds send daily hang stacks and timings, never your files, URLs or text.

rows.title: Record Usage Patterns
rows.help: Counts how you use cmux on this Mac. Nothing you type is recorded; nothing is sent.

rows.title: Keep Location in Photos and Videos
rows.help: When off, location data is removed from photos and videos before they are attached.

rows.title: Their Bubble Color
rows.help: Right-click a chat and choose Chat Colors to set its own.

rows.title: Their Text Color
rows.help: Right-click a chat and choose Chat Colors to set its own.

rows.title: My Bubble Color
rows.help: Right-click a chat and choose Chat Colors to set its own.

rows.title: My Text Color
rows.help: Right-click a chat and choose Chat Colors to set its own.

rows.title: Channels
rows.help: Show Channels below Home in the sidebar.

rows.title: Bubble Style
rows.help: iMessage: blue and gray. Theme: your theme's colors.

rows.title: Dock Edge
rows.help: The window edge the Chief docks to.

rows.title: Show Chief When Opening Workspaces
rows.help: Links in the Chief open their workspace with the Chief over it. Esc hides it.

rows.title: Engine
rows.help: Auto uses this Mac's Chief while it runs, else the Hosted Chief.

rows.title: Chief Sees Your Screen When It Opens
rows.help: The floating Chief takes one look at your screen when it opens. The eye turns it off.

rows.title: Floating Chief Style
rows.help: How the Chief looks floating over a workspace. Drag any style by its grip.

rows.title: Show Chief Pet
rows.help: A small Chief over every app shows agent events. ⌃⌥⌘C opens its reply box.

rows.title: Show the Feed in Chief
rows.help: Feed notices show among the Chief's messages. The Chief does not read them.

rows.title: Server
rows.help: Self-hosted: a Tailscale MagicDNS address, such as http://mini.tail1234.ts.net:7320.

rows.title: Send System Shortcuts to the Remote Mac
rows.help: Shortcuts like ⌘Tab and ⌘Space go to the other Mac. Needs Accessibility.

rows.title: Show Shortcuts When Holding a Modifier
rows.help: Hold Command or Control for 0.30 seconds to show shortcut hints.

rows.title: Send Agent Permission Requests to the Feed
rows.help: Each request's tool and command summary goes to your own cmux feed, so your iPhone can answer it.

rows.title: GitHub Inbox
rows.help: Inbox shows your GitHub notifications

rows.title: Refresh Interval
rows.help: Seconds between GitHub refreshes. Refresh in the Inbox runs immediately.

rows.title: Copy Agent Notifications to the Feed
rows.help: Agent and cmux notify notifications go to your feed and can reach your iPhone.

rows.title: Copy Terminal Notifications to the Feed
rows.help: Terminal notifications can contain secrets. Off sends nothing.

rows.title: Pin Needs You in Chief
rows.help: Pins open requests and questions at the top of the Chief's chat.

rows.title: Ring Agent Chat Panes
rows.help: Ring an agent chat's pane when its turn ends, until you click or type in it.

rows.title: Flash the Pane When Read
rows.help: Clicking an unread pane, typing in it or jumping to it flashes its ring as it goes.

rows.title: Move the Workspace to the Top
rows.help: A notification moves its workspace to the top, unless you are looking at it.

rows.title: Move the Workspace to the Top When Its Agent Finishes
rows.help: Unless you are looking at its pane.

rows.title: Bounce Dock Icon
rows.help: When a notification alerts while cmux isn't the active app.

rows.title: Quiet Hours
rows.help: No banners or sounds between these times.

rows.title: Show Message in Banners
rows.help: Whether a banner shows what the agent said, or only where and what state.

rows.title: Burst Cooldown
rows.help: Many notifications at once sound once. 0 turns it off.

rows.title: Volume
rows.help: Sounds cmux plays itself. A banner's default sound follows the system alert volume.

rows.title: Quiet After Typing
rows.help: A pane typed into this recently is marked read at once. 0 turns it off.

rows.title: Timeout
rows.help: Used when a source clears after a timeout.

rows.title: Notify When a Run Takes
rows.help: cmux status run notifies when the command took at least this long.

rows.title: Notify Even When the Terminal Is Visible
Allow iPhone Connections
rows.help: The cmux app on your iPhone can open this Mac's workspaces, on the same account.

rows.title: Terminal Size When Shared
rows.help: The size of a terminal shown on this Mac and a phone at once.

rows.title: Machine Color
rows.help: By machine name: "#RRGGBB" or an accent name, such as red or blue.

rows.title: Let Agents Use Cloud Without Asking
rows.help: Agents, `cmux cloud` in a terminal and scripts create Cloud machines, move chats to Cloud and start sessions there with no card asking you first. Your plan's limits still apply. Only you can change this.

rows.title: New Cloud Workspaces Start In
rows.help: Current Folder copies your git working copy to the new machine.

rows.title: Run New Workspaces in Cloud
rows.help: Each new workspace gets its own Cloud machine, and its chats run there.

rows.title: Save a Checkpoint Before Each Cloud Chat Turn
rows.help: Back to Before This Turn restores the machine in seconds. Keeps the newest few.

rows.title: Show Your Cloud Machine's Screen on Your Phone
rows.help: View only, streamed by this Mac while the page is open.

rows.title: Show This Mac's Workspaces on Your Phone While It's Off
rows.help: Stores workspace names, colors and unread counts. No paths, titles or output.

rows.title: Keep Mac Awake for Your Phone
rows.help: Closing the lid still puts the Mac to sleep.

rows.title: Always Allowed SSH Link Hosts
rows.help: ssh:// links from other apps connect to these hosts without asking.

rows.title: Developer Tools for cmux Pages
rows.help: Inspect Element and ⌥⌘I in chats, Home, Markdown and Settings.

rows.title: Live Code
rows.help: Swift changes you compile apply to the running app. Takes effect after cmux restarts.

rows.title: Screen Sharing for Joined Machines
rows.help: Shows Screen sharing and Control in Settings > Devices once this Mac joins.

rows.title: Show Preview Features
rows.help: Unfinished surfaces, such as the agent session's coverage label and Pull requests view.

rows.title: Voice Room
rows.help: While a room is open, cmux sends a transcript of your mic and your screen's text to it.

rows.title: Voice Room Address
rows.help: The room's web address. Empty uses the room server on this Mac.

rows.title: Internal Developer Mode
rows.help: Shows "Debug: …" commands in the Command Palette.

rows.title: Device Hub Address
rows.help: The device hub for Mac Screen sharing. Empty uses the built-in one.

rows.title: Relay Only
rows.help: Mac Screen tabs connect only through the relay, to test it.
